package.name: mower_vision
package.description: Consumers of the NPU perception outputs for the Airseekers Tron. obstacle_guard turns det_ros detections (vision_msgs/Detection2DArray) into /vision/obstacle_close and, when stop_on_close is set, a zero-twist burst on /cmd_vel_emergency plus a /cutter_off call. Also ships perception.launch.py (det_ros + seg_ros + obstacle_guard) and fake_camera, a synthetic image publisher for dev hosts.
